## Task 1 – The setup check

**In the slides.** Wait for the R engine, run the setup cell, and check that `housing` has 1,014 rows and that the last line reports −19.97 percentage points. Then work through the warm-up on the three Rs, on the next slide.

[Open the slides at Task 1](../../live/short.html#/hands-on-1-get-yourself-running){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank"} [Open the webR workspace at Task 1](../../lab.qmd#task-1-setup){.btn .btn-outline-primary target="_blank"}

If the slides do not load, run the same cells in the webR workspace, which gives the same numbers.

## Task 3 – The reproduction

**In the slides.** Run the cell that reads the public file `housing_original.csv`, then work through the cells of the analyst given to you.
